notes: The two possessive clauses are read by rule 43: the written היה takes the *had* itself and its לְ goes unrepresented; the existential אַיִן takes *had no*, heads on the negation under rule 50, and its לְ goes unrepresented likewise.
אַחַת as substantival numeral rectum takes both the *of* (rule 19) and the determiner English writes before it (rules 15, 31), no noun standing for it to determine.
In *the name of the other* the article on the rectum takes the *the* standing before its own word and the construct takes a supplied one (rule 29, arthrous case); nothing is fronted.
